messages:
sophia: Quick follow-up to the PIN metadata RFC. I sketched a small addition: a 'lease' (TTL) plus an explicit 'compatibility_gates' list evaluated at routing time. Rationale: lets us auto-evict stale pins and avoid silent KV/embedding format incompatibilities when we swap model variants.

kevin: Can you paste a minimal schema example? :eyes:

sophia: Sure, pseudo-JSON for discussion:
```
{
  "pin": {
    "model": "redwood/gptx-3",
    "version": "2026-03-01",
    "lease": { "expires_at": "2026-06-01T00:00:00Z", "grace_days": 3 },
    "compatibility_gates": ["kv-format:v2","embedding-dim:1024"],
    "enforcement": "warn"
  },
  "fallback_priority": ["gptx-3-quant","gptx-2"]
}
```

danielle: I like the lease concept. Two operational points: 1) we need a migration plan for existing pins, 2) default lease should be infinite unless the owner opts in, otherwise enterprise customers could see unexpected evictions.

sophia: Agreed on defaults. The team discussed opt-in expiry; we only set a default lease when explicitly provided. For rotation workflows we also proposed an `epoch` tag so you can rotate pins without breaking routing semantics.

mike: Operational question: when a compat gate fails, what should happen? Options: 1) block routing (fail), 2) route but warn, or 3) automatic fallback. We should define an enforcement enum and a triage matrix.

kevin: From runtime perspective, checks like `kv-format` or `weight-quant` are cheap and safe to validate synchronously. Things like `embedding-dim` need an offline confirm or quick smoke eval — they are riskier to fail fast on unless enforcement=fail.

eva: Product note: tenants will want a console surface to inspect pin leases, compat flags, and audit links to the eval that produced the compat fingerprint. Also a way to request lease extensions.

sophia: Good call. I'll add `compat_fingerprint` and `compat_proof_link` to the schema. Example: `compat_fingerprint: "sha256:abcd..."` and `compat_proof_link: "https://console.redwood.ai/evals/123"`.

deploy-bot: CI:pin-schema-migrations passed for branch model-pin-lease (job id 3421) :white_check_mark:

kevin: Also proposing a small ops CLI for creating pins:
```
redwood pin set --model redwood/gptx-3 --version 2026-03-01 \
  --lease 90d --compat kv-format:v2,embedding-dim:1024 --enforcement fallback
```

danielle: Migration plan sketch: 1) accept new fields in schema as non-breaking, 2) backfill `enforcement=warn` for existing pins, 3) run an audit to surface pins without explicit owners or proof links, 4) notify owners by email/console before any automatic expiry.

sophia: I'll draft a short RFC follow-up with these decisions and a rollout checklist: console display, CLI support, audit job, operator playbook, and a rollback plan. Thanks all :thumbsup:
